description_text:
The New York City Human Resources Administration through its Office of Homelessness Prevention Administration intends to renew one (1) contract with the contractor listed below for Homebase Homelessness Prevention Network, located at 90 Beaver Street, Brooklyn, NY 11206.

Riseboro Community Partnership Inc
565 Bushwick Avenue
Brooklyn, NY 11206

The renewal term of the contract will be from 07/01/2027  06/30/2030. Anyone who has comments on the performance of the contractor, or the proposed renewal of the contracts may contact Stacey Cedeno at (929)-221-5887. This Notice is for informational purposes only.
